items.title: Connecticut’s Forgotten Witch Trials
items.description: When you think of witch trials in colonial America, Salem, Massachusetts, probably springs to mind. But Connecticut was prosecuting suspected witches decades before Salem became synonymous with witchcraft hysteria. Between 1647 and 1663, the colony experienced an early wave of witchcraft cases, with approximately 37 accusations and 11 executions. These cases reveal a lesser-known chapter […]
